title.zh: 牛顿法求根 · 沿切线一刀跳向零点
title.en: Newton’s Method · Leap to the Root Along a Tangent

desc.zh: 用切线代替曲线，每一刀都把误差的位数翻倍；失败的几种情形也画给你看。
desc.en: Replace the curve by its tangent and jump to where the tangent hits zero; each jump roughly doubles the correct digits. The ways it fails are drawn too.

legacyLayout._note: Whitespace and markup of the hand-written lesson this page was converted from, so the conversion could be checked byte for byte (specs/site-template.md §3c).
